 Kyle Madson Niners Wire Updated Nov. 8, 2026, 5:33 p.m. ET The San Francisco 49ers are back from their bye week to host the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday at Levi's Stadium.
 This marks the 49ers first home game against the Raiders since 2018 when they were still the Oakland Raiders. San Francisco is coming off a week away, while the Raiders are coming off a win over the New York Jets that snapped their four-game losing skid.
 Niners Wire is bringing you live updates, scores and highlights from the game. Follow along.
 49ers vs Raiders score
 Quarter Q1 Q2 Q3 Q4 Score 
 Raiders 0 10 - - 10 
 49ers 14 7 - - 21 
 5:33 pm ET Share this update Raiders score on 50-yard field goal, cut 49ers lead to 11
 Kyle Madson
 Vegas couldn't capitalize on a big kick return by Dylan Laube that put them at the 49ers 42 to begin their third series. They wound up settling for a 50-yard field goal from Matt Gay to cut the 49ers' lead to 21-10 with 1:12 left in the first half. 49ers DE Nick Bosa had a tackle for loss on a tight end screen. Then DT Osa Odighizuwa had a tackle for loss on a run that put the Raiders in a third-and-19. They handed off on third-and-long to get into long field goal range.
 5:23 pm ET Share this update 49ers score on Christian McCaffrey's 2nd TD
 Kyle Madson
 San Francisco responded quickly to the Raiders touchdown. Brock Purdy guided his team on a 12-play, 84-yard touchdown drive that culminated in a 12-yard touchdown pass from Purdy to McCaffrey. That duo has accounted for all three of the 49ers' touchdowns. McCaffrey has rushing and receiving scores. Purdy has a rushing TD to go along with his passing TD. On that drive Purdy hit WRs Jordan Watkins and KhaDarel Hodge as he looks to get comfortable with the 49ers' makeshift receiving corps. The 49ers also converted a fourth-and-1 to keep the drive alive deep in their own territory. San Francisco is averaging 6.7 yards per play.
 5:10 pm ET Share this update Raiders score TD on Kirk Cousins sneak, cut 49ers lead in half
 Kyle Madson
 Las Vegas badly needed a touchdown and they responded with an excellent drive. They went 62 yards on eight plays and never faced much resistance from the 49ers defense. Cousins capped the drive with a one-yard TD run. He also completed all four of his throws for 48 yards.
 5:03 pm ET Share this update 49ers vs. Raiders score: San Francisco leads 14-0 after first quarter
 Kyle Madson
 It was all 49ers in the first quarter. They ran 24 plays to the Raiders' eight, and gained 164 yards to the Raiders' 44. The Raiders were on the move to end the quarter, though. They're at the 49ers' 23 to open the second period.
 4:56 pm ET Share this update 49ers score again on Brock Purdy rushing TD
 Kyle Madson
 The 49ers now lead 14-0 after Purdy used his legs to punch in a score on a play action look from the 1. He rolled right, used a pump fake to create enough space to get to the corner. He ran it four times for 32 yards on that series which went 89 yards in 13 plays. San Francisco on that drive overcame an intentional grounding penalty and a false start that put them behind the sticks.
 4:41 pm ET Share this update 49ers get ball back after Raiders three-and-out
 Kyle Madson
 San Francisco forced a quick three-and-out from the Raiders offense. QB Kirk Cousins missed a checkdown thanks to some heavy pressure on first down. RB Ashton Jeanty picked up eight yards on a second-down run, but then Cousins sailed a throw to TE Brock Bowers on third-and-2 thanks in part to tight coverage from 49ers CB Upton Stout. The 49ers offense will start at its own 11 after a good punt by Raiders P AJ Cole.
 4:37 pm ET Share this update 49ers score first, take 7-0 lead vs. Raiders
 Kyle Madson
 Sheesh. 12 plays, 69 yards and a touchdown for San Francisco on its first drive. Christian McCaffrey capped the series with a one-yard touchdown run to mark his seventh consecutive game with a rushing score. McCaffrey rushed four times for 21 yards on the series and the 49ers are up 7-0 with 9:32 left in the first quarter.
 4:28 pm ET Share this update 49ers vs. Raiders is underway
 Kyle Madson
 San Francisco received the opening kick. Kaelon Black was back deep to receive it and returned it out to the 31 where Brock Purdy and the 49ers offense will begin the game.

 2:35 pm ET Share this update Raiders vs 49ers injury report
 Kyle Madson
 Raiders — OUT: DT Thomas Booker (ankle); QUESTIONABLE: CB Darien Porter (groin)
 49ers — OUT: WR Mike Evans (ribs, Achilles), WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring); QUESTIONABLE: CB Nate Hobbs (adductor), S Siran Neal (knee), CB Upton Stout (shoulder)
 2:15 pm ET Share this update Raiders vs 49ers predictions, betting odds
 Kyle Madson
 Odds via BetMGM . 
 Match-up prediction: The 49ers aren't healthy offensively, but the Raiders bring to Santa Clara one of the NFL's worst defenses. Even if San Francisco has some struggles offensively they should be able to run up points on the Vegas defense. With their health improving on the other side of the ball we should see the 49ers come up with enough stops against a Raiders offense that struggles to run the ball. 49ers 34, Raiders 27 
 Spread: 49ers -9.5 (-110), Raiders +9.5 (-108)
 Over/under: Over 52 (-108), Under 52 (-110)
 Moneyline: 49ers -475, Raiders +375
 1:50 pm ET Share this update Raiders vs 49ers weather forecast
 Kyle Madson
 It's a nice day for football in Santa Clara. It's mostly cloudy with temperature at kickoff around 69 degrees. There are no crazy winds or rain in the forecast.
